name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 56 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
